description: Do LastModified, Bookmark and the current row of a dynaset survive the Rollback of a level in which that recordset edited one row and added another? Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid), opened writable through DBEngine.OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0). Open dynaset rs on SELECT ID, V, Z FROM R ORDER BY ID; BeginTrans; rs.MoveFirst; rs.Edit; V = 777; rs.Update; LastModified; Bookmark; rs.AddNew; ID = 30, V = 300, Z = 'lm'; rs.Update; LastModified; Bookmark; state of rs; Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; LastModified; Bookmark; state of rs; rs.Move(0); LastModified; state of rs; close; read R through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
